title: First categorical finite Cech exactness makes quotient maps epic on basis sections
statement: Let (C,J), A and B have the finite covering basis hypotheses of [stage3-categorical-finite-cover-local-zero]. Let 0→F→I→Q→0 be short exact in A-valued sheaves. Suppose the categorical finite Cech complex of F is exact in degree 1 for every finite B-cover of every B-object. Then I(V)→Q(V) is epic in A for every B-object V.

source.place: Lemma 21.10.8, with coefficient epimorphic refinements and finite products replacing elementwise lifts.

proof.text: Apply the local-lift test to the cokernel projection of I(V)→Q(V). Fix a finite B-cover and a local lift cochain in I of a generalized Q(V)-section.

Its differential maps to zero in the degree-one Q-product. Evaluation is left exact, so lift that differential uniquely through the degree-one F-product. Monicity in degree two and d squared zero show that this lift is a cocycle. Exactness in degree one gives a primitive after an epimorphism of coefficient objects.

Subtract the image of this primitive from the I-cochain. Its differential is zero. The categorical degree-zero Cech cocycle calculation gives compatibility on overlaps, and the sheaf axiom glues it to an I(V)-section. The sheaf uniqueness axiom makes the Q-augmentation monic, so this global lift has the required Q-image.
The cokernel projection kills the refined section. Cancel the coefficient epimorphism and use the local-lift test to show that projection is zero. Hence I(V)→Q(V) is epic.

theorem epi_app_of_finite_cech_exact_one
    (B : C → Prop)
    (hcov : ∀ V, B V → ∀ R ∈ J V, ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Over V),
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n), B (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U y).left) ∧
      (∀ a, R (U a).hom) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun a ↦ (U a).left) (fun a ↦ (U a).hom) ∈ J V)
    {S : ShortComplex (Sheaf J A)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hF : ∀ V, B V → ∀ {n : ℕ} (U : Fin n → Over V),
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n), B (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U y).left) →
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun a ↦ (U a).left) (fun a ↦ (U a).hom) ∈ J V →
      ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj ((Over.forget V).op ⋙ S.X₁.obj)).ExactAt 1)
    (V : C) (hV : B V) : Epi (S.g.hom.app (op V))
